thread:
jess: Quick idea — build a "cost preview" slider in Console so PMs can tweak routing/quantization and immediately see token burn + est monthly delta. Useful for rollouts.
kai: love this. Is this strictly a UI calc or do we need a new internal API to get per-request model-unit costs? :thinking:
marta: we'll need both. UI for preview, but the numbers should come from a canonical service so they match the billing model. else confusion later.
leo: agree. propose /internal/cost_preview endpoint that accepts: model, avg_input_tokens, avg_output_tokens, cache_hit_rate, quant_profile, routing_policy
samir: can we include a sample rate param? previews should tolerate sampled telemetry for historical baselines.
ops-bot: deploys: cost-preview-svc v0.1 -> canary in eng-platform cluster
jess: rough API sketch in case it's useful:
```
GET /internal/cost_preview?model=redwood/gpt-large&in=32&out=64&cache_hit=0.25&quant=4bit&routing=hot
Response 200:
{
  "per_request_tokens": "96",
  "per_token_cost": "0.00012",
  "per_request_cost": "0.01152",
  "monthly_estimate": "138.24",
  "assumptions": "1 RPS steady, 30d month, sample=0.1"
}
```
kai: small ask: mark these preview numbers as "estimate" in UI and don't imply invoice-ready. finance will freak.
marta: also highlight origin of assumptions (sampling window, tail percentiles) — folks will ask why numbers change.
leo: backend details: must pull model-sku unit price + active batching elasticity factor + cache-savings heuristic. caching is messy: need to decide whether preview assumes kv-prefix caching or session-level.
samir: for rollout UX we should add a toggle: "simulate routing shift" where slider moves % traffic from default-model -> lower-cost variant and shows delta. that helps sales/PMs.
jess: exactly what I was thinking. show both immediate per-token delta and 30/90/365 day projections.
kai: telemetry question: do we compute baseline using raw request logs or via sampled request-attributor? raw is expensive. propose historical aggregation job that stores per-model averages at 5m granularity and cost-preview pulls that.
marta: +1. keep preview fast and cacheable. we can invalidate when new model pricing or quant profiles change.
leo: edge-case: what about chain-of-models (reranking + gen)? preview needs multi-model chain support. maybe allow multiple model params and show stacked costs.
ops-bot: note: new schema change: cost-preview requires service account scope "cost:read" — opening PR.
samir: UX nit: slider should allow negative deltas (cost savings) and show confidence band (±) from sampling noise. show both absolute and percent.
jess: decision items: 1) backend endpoint /internal/cost_preview (canonical), 2) historical 5m aggregates job, 3) UI slider + routing-sim toggle, 4) mark as "estimate" and show assumptions. who wants action items?
leo: I'll prototype backend + batching heuristic. estimate 3 days.
kai: I'll own the UI mock + wording with product. 2 days.
marta: I'll spec the sampling/aggregation and finance sign-off. ping me when mock is done.
samir: I'll add chain-of-models support design and confidence calculations.
jess: great — let's sync tomorrow 10am. thanks! :rocket:
